status: draft; frozen together with config/motion_output_contract_20261108.json after user review (develop_logs/notes/20261108_batch_design_decisions.md section 13 step 4-5), before any batch result

builds_on.output_contract: config/motion_output_contract_20261108.json (what the generation side writes; the per-pair measurability is fixed there)
builds_on.evalkit: config/evalkit_v12_20261108.json (repair the floor first, then the loads)

user_decisions.2026-11-08 15:16: the large run is configurable; it may run only the repaired (self) floor first, with the method-floor loads and the remaining lumbar rows filled in later; nothing else is dropped
user_decisions.2026-11-08 15:16 lumbar: lumbar first on a stratified subsample (1-2 seeds per method x task x text condition), filled in later by input hash; the large batch is not run now
user_decisions.2026-11-08 15:16 muscles: neck and shoulder stay reserved; the generation side stores the native rotations they need (contract L4)

manifest_fields.legacy: rows without the L2 fields: task and seed parsed from the id (_t<task>_s<seed>); text_condition null

rows.dedup: rows with byte-identical inputs (input_sha256) enter medians once; rows and unique_inputs both reported
rows.clusters: text -> task (two levels), reported per text condition (design section 4)

method_floor.floor: the method's declared floor plus the per-clip correction (evalkit v1.2 floor.per_clip_correction)

self_floor.floor: self_floor_shift of the method-floor frames (still-landmark median), refitted, no per-clip correction
self_floor.requires: the method-floor row with residual (its frames.npz)

self.result: primary for every dimension; method-floor loads missing (not reported, not imputed)

method.result: method_floor_* loads only; check.json load_arm says so

run_modes.fill_in: self then both: pass 1 rows gain ergo and muscle from their cached fit (evalkit.run.add_dims, no refit; verified bit-identical to a full evaluation on smoke rows), pass 2 rows are skipped
run_modes.command: scripts/run_evalkit_batch.sh --manifest M --out DIR --dims residual,ergo,muscle,kinematic[,upper] --arms self|both|method [--lumbar-per-cell N] [--offset-reference FROZEN.json] [--no-distribution]
run_modes.planned_order: self first (primary results), both as the supplement; 约定，未经推演 (cost driven, user 15:16)

muscle.addable: true when the row has residual

upper.cost_note: smoke8x5 under CPU contention: lumbar median about 1190 s per row, about 80% of CPU; to be re-timed on an idle CPU before the batch

dimensions.cost_note: 约定，未经推演: per-motion-second costs are smoke estimates under contention (SECONDS_PER_MOTION_SECOND in evalkit_batch.py)

lumbar_subsample.stratum: method x condition x task x text_condition
lumbar_subsample.within_stratum: the first --lumbar-per-cell seeds in ascending seed order (deterministic; seeds are generator seeds, unrelated to the outcome)
lumbar_subsample.fill_in: rerun with a larger --lumbar-per-cell (0: every row): rows already measured are skipped by their batch key, newly sampled rows gain upper without refitting
lumbar_subsample.reporting: lumbar statistics state the subsample (rows, strata); not-sampled rows have upper_lumbar_status not_sampled and enter no lumbar statistic

per_row.evalkit.json: receipt (floors, offsets, dims, spec, commits), batch (skip key), row (manifest row), residual, ergo, muscle, kinematic, upper
per_row.frames.npz: per-frame arrays: times, scored, unmeasurable, residual_*, contact_* / elevation_*, ergo_*, muscle_*, net_moment_*
per_row.error.json: failure of the last attempt (kept; never deleted by a later success of another dimension)

per_run.check.json: load_arm, per-method medians and statuses, references, per_row

row_status.partial_failed: evalkit.json and error.json both present: a later attempt failed (an added dimension, or a re-evaluation whose stale result remains); inspected per row, never pooled silently

statuses.not_evaluated: manifest rows without evalkit.json (counted per method in check.json)
statuses.measurability: per method x evaluator from the output contract (measurable / with_caveat / to_verify / not_measurable)

skip_key.self_floor_row: the same key on the __selffloor row (floor_m from the method-floor frames)
skip_key.rule: same key: skip; same key except dims, old dims a subset and the added dims addable: add without refit; anything else: full re-evaluation

offset_reference.decision: user 2026-11-08 17:10: freeze the per-method offset reference from a registered set before the batch (the manifest median would move as rows stream in and re-evaluate every row of the method)
offset_reference.how: evalkit_batch.py offset-reference --manifest REGISTERED --rows DIR --out FROZEN.json, once; batches pass --offset-reference FROZEN.json; a method missing from it stops the batch
offset_reference.set: registered 2026-11-08 18:39 (user 18:38): evalkit_batch.py manifest-offset-reference: native matrix, paused clock, per method x condition x task the lowest seed, one row per distinct input; Kimodo from E4 (one case per text x constraint type x correction); 344 rows (ardy 48, chois 24, closd 24, dart 24, kimodo 52, motionlcm 14, omnicontrol 38, primal 96). Clock paused only, rows weighted equally per distinct input: 约定，未经推演
offset_reference.assumption: the reference reflects the method's foot-joint convention, not the task
offset_reference.drift: every batch also writes its own manifest median (floor_offsets.json _batch_median) next to the frozen value; reported descriptively, never used to recompute
offset_reference.frozen_file: config/evalkit_offset_reference_20261108.json (written once by offset-reference; failed rows listed, not retried)

skip_key.method_floor_row_note: offset_reference_m is the frozen value, so streamed rows leave earlier keys unchanged

evaluators.distribution: official evaluation batches only (design section 5); not the per-task rows
evaluators.neck: reserved: needs head / neck / thorax global orientation (contract L4)

settings_sensitivity.threshold_pm_0p5cm: descriptive band in check (residual_positive_share_depth_-+5mm, rescore only): implemented
settings_sensitivity.contact_tolerance_2_3cm: not implemented (design section 8); needs a re-evaluation arm, to be registered before the batch
settings_sensitivity.post_hoc_correction_group: not implemented; scope decided by the user after the precheck (design section 8)

conventions_not_derived: stratum definition (method x condition x task x text_condition)
offset reference set (paused clock, lowest seed per condition x task, distinct inputs)
